implemented_files.purpose: New Foundation feedback entry point with phased Customer Voice audience paths.
Confirms Feedback is not present in primary navigation.
Adds Share Your Experience organization footer link.
Documents the route and Customer Voice environment variable configuration.
Defines phased survey plan and privacy boundaries.
Validates donor, volunteer/program, participant, and sponsor audiences separately.

lowest_risk_first_survey.reason: It captures broad operational learning after programs, events, and volunteer work while avoiding donor payment records and recipient-sensitive assistance details.

production_validation.footer_link: Share Your Experience appears in the live jmerrill.foundation footer.
production_validation.primary_navigation: Feedback is not present in primary navigation.
production_validation.phase_1_public_link: The Program or Volunteer Experience card links to the live Customer Voice survey.
production_validation.controlled_response: Submitted controlled production response with 5-star rating and launch-validation text.
production_validation.customer_voice_report: Customer Voice report shows Total responses 1, 5.0 average rating, and the controlled test response text.
production_validation.dataverse_note: Customer Voice was created in JM1-CRM-Core. Direct Dataverse metadata queries did not expose response/survey logical tables by expected names, so Customer Voice reporting is the confirmed response proof for v1 closeout.

not_performed: Donor, participant, and sponsor surveys were not launched in v1 because Program/Volunteer is the approved lowest-risk public launch path.
No donor, participant, sponsor, or volunteer production records were changed.
final_recommendation: FOUNDATION FEEDBACK = LIVE. Keep Program/Volunteer live as v1, monitor controlled and organic responses, then activate donor, participant, and sponsor surveys only after their separate privacy validation passes.
